title: Analysis of Moral Judgement on Reddit

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting self-reported gender tags (e.g., [M27], [F25]) from Reddit post titles and using a fine-tuned BERT classifier to determine if male users receive disproportionately more negative moral judgements than female users, evaluated via chi-square tests of independence and logistic regression.

Extracting self-reported age from Reddit post titles and using a logistic regression model alongside classifier predictions to evaluate whether a user's age correlates with an increased likelihood of receiving a negative moral judgement.
